pages.text: Six iron ingots, two copper ingots and one glass. Crafted empty. Place inside a sealed room. ORSA advises against opening the vessel to check whether it is full.

pages.title: Stored Oxygen
pages.text: Default capacity: 1,200 player-seconds. One second supports one player for one second; ten existing canister units equal one player-second.$(br2)Stores up to 4 spare supply units and delivers up to 8 units per second. A full tank fills in five minutes with four units spare. These first-pass values are configurable. It does not create oxygen or pressurize a room.

pages.title: One Shared Budget
pages.text: Production serves breathing and active ordinary combustion first. Connected tanks cover a deficit up to their output and contents. Only spare production refills reservoirs, Core canisters, intact EVA reserves and airlock reserves; eligible devices share it fairly.$(br2)Tank output cannot recharge storage. Multiple tanks add capacity and output once within their existing pool. A tank cannot connect unrelated rooms.

pages.title: Automatic Shutoff
pages.text: A breach shuts the valve: input and output stop, contents stay inside. Unknown or unloaded rooms also suspend transfers. After resealing, the tank reconnects when normal room gas returns. It cannot make an open room breathable.$(br2)Harvest with a pickaxe to move the exact stored reserve. Explosion destruction loses the vessel and its contents. The front bars show contents; amber means shutoff or discharge. The room gauge shows ON RESERVE while storage supports the deficit.
